messages:
Asha Iyer: I ran a recurrence heatmap for MarMay and correlated against SLA breaches + customer escalations. High-level: three persistent clusters (cache eviction, fallback loops, grpc resets) plus infra blips. Posting a short prioritized list and suggested owners so we can assign follow-ups.

Markus Lind: paste counts so we can decide which to triage first?

Asha Iyer: snapshot from the heatmap query:

```
cluster | incidents | sla_hits
CACHE_EVICT_HOTSPOTS | 24 | 9
FALLBACK_LOOP_CASCADE | 15 | 6
GRPC_RESET_OLD_NODES | 10 | 3
INFRA_EGRESS_SPIKES | 6 | 2
OTHER | 8 | 1
```

Vera Chen: i'll take CACHE_EVICT_HOTSPOTS. Plan: (1) per-tenant eviction caps on hot prefixes, (2) adaptive TTLs for large workloads, (3) eviction latency metrics + dashboard. ETA 3w. will add a feature flag and rollback doc.

Sam Ortiz: i'll own FALLBACK_LOOP_CASCADE. Fixes: add rollout cooldown, introduce per-pool fallback hysteresis, and a canary gate in the console; add an eval prompt set to catch silent regressions in canaries. ETA 2w.

Markus Lind: i'll coordinate with eng-infra on GRPC_RESET_OLD_NODES and infra egress spikes. For grpc: bump keepalive + reprovision old nodes; for egress: add retry/backoff and alert rate-limiting. ETA 10d for initial patches.

Asha Iyer: I'll create epic INC-4466: "Recurrence heatmap remediation Mar-May" and seed the tickets. incidents-bot, please create epic and tag recurrence, priority-medium.

incidents-bot: Created epic INC-4466: "Recurrence heatmap remediation Mar-May" labels: recurrence, priority-medium. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4466

Vera Chen: action items for INC-4466:
- Vera Chen  per-tenant eviction caps + adaptive TTLs + load tests + rollback docs  due 2026-04-20
- Sam Ortiz  rollout cooldown + fallback hysteresis + canary gate + eval set  due 2026-04-15
- Markus Lind  grpc keepalive bump + node reprovision plan; infra egress backoff  due 2026-04-12
- Asha Iyer  dashboards + weekly pulse check + recurrence monitoring alert tweaks  due 2026-04-08

Markus Lind: quick risk note: eviction changes could affect Dedicated p95. ensure we run 2x peak QPS load tests and include p95/p99 checks.

Vera Chen: noted. i'll add load test config and baseline comparisons to the PR.

Asha Iyer: scheduling a 30m triage Wed 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC to confirm blockers and owners. If anything urgent pops up, ping here. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Recurrence heatmap triage: INC-4466" on 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC.
